read.en: Coherent fell 13.0% on Nov 5 to $169.76, trading $160.24–188.60 on 2.1 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($196.52), 10-day ($212.60), 30-day ($259.87) and 100-day ($297.78) and the rising 200-day ($296.47). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($239.76), and RSI is 28, oversold.
read.zh: Coherent 11月5日下跌 13.0%，收于 $169.76，盘中区间 $160.24–188.60，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.1 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$196.52）、10 日（$212.60）、30 日（$259.87）和 100 日均线（$297.78）以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.47）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$239.76），RSI 为 28，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $187.2–189.6 and $180 supports, now resistance, and the close is the lowest since Dec 2, 2025. Resistance is $180, then $187.2–189.6 (Nov 4 low, Nov 5 high, late-December lows) and $196.5–198.7 (5-day, Nov 2 low). Support is $167.5–168.6 (Jan 9 low, Nov 10, 2025 high), then $158.2–160.2 (Dec 3 and Nov 5 lows). A close above $180 would target $187–190; below $167.5, $158–160.
